class.name: NetwHandleLedger
class.brief_description: Mints and validates one kind of RID for records owned by GDScript.
class.description: One ledger owns one handle kind. A RID minted by another ledger is invalid, so field sets, interest layers, and later record kinds cannot be confused even though they share the [RID] value type. The ledger stores only a monotonic integer identity. The GDScript subsystem keeps the data named by each RID and releases it with [method rid_free] or [method clear].

method.name: clear
method.description: Frees every owned RID and restarts identity numbering for a new session.

method.name: id_count
method.description: Returns the number of RIDs this ledger currently owns.

method.name: rid_create
method.description: Mints a fresh RID whose integer identity is one greater than the previous mint.

method.name: rid_free
method.description: Frees [param rid] and returns [code]true[/code], or returns [code]false[/code] when this ledger does not own it.

method.name: rid_from_id
method.description: Returns the owned RID for [param id], or an invalid RID when the identity is unknown or was freed.

method.name: rid_is_valid
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] only while this ledger owns [param rid].
